description: This Java source file defines the EventSnapshotCleanupCoordinator class, which is an Akka actor responsible for orchestrating the cleanup of old event snapshots and reporting status within a distributed system. It manages streams of persistence IDs, credit decisions, and cleanup responses, coordinating cleanup commands across different shard regions, and reporting metrics and statuses.

classes.name: EventSnapshotCleanupCoordinator
classes.description: An Akka actor that coordinates the cleanup of event snapshots and old persistence data while reporting status and metrics in a distributed environment.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props configuration for instantiating the EventSnapshotCleanupCoordinator actor.

methods.name: preEnhanceStreamingBehavior
methods.description: Sets up message handlers for CreditDecision and CleanupPersistenceResponse messages, enqueuing them for status reporting.

methods.name: parseConfig
methods.description: Parses the configuration for persistence cleanup from the provided Config object.

methods.name: getEntityIdWithRevisionSource
methods.description: Constructs a source stream of EntityIdWithRevision objects for processing.

methods.name: creditSource
methods.description: Creates a source stream emitting credit decision values.

methods.name: persistenceIdSource
methods.description: Creates a source stream that provides persistence IDs from registered sources.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Provides the main source stream of cleanup responses by querying shard regions with persistence IDs and credit decisions.

methods.name: askShardRegionForCleanup
methods.description: Sends cleanup requests to shard regions asynchronously and processes the responses.

methods.name: postEnhanceStatusReport
methods.description: Adds current status data regarding credit decisions and actions to the status report builder.

methods.name: renderCreditDecision
methods.description: Converts a credit decision pair into a JSON object for reporting.

methods.name: renderAction
methods.description: Converts a cleanup response into a JSON object for reporting, including start time, status, and messages.

methods.name: getResponseMessage
methods.description: Constructs a human-readable message from a cleanup response, including error info if applicable.

methods.name: getCleanupCommand
methods.description: Creates a cleanup command with a timestamp header for an entity ID.
